'''J'Nes B'Sar''' ('''"True Gatherings"''') were organized meetings where [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] came together to listen to the listed to the wisdom and spiritual teachings of the [[M'Nes]]. J'Nes B'Sar's usually featured one of the [[K'Kela Mey]] speaking.
